current_batch: Current source adds the missing cloud direct-provider boundary for administrator-managed Image 2 and Retouch revisions. Generation uses fixed allowlisted /v1/images/generations; Retouch reads base/reference/mask bytes from shared CAS and calls multipart /v1/images/edits. Masked non-PNG bases are safely converted to PNG after EXIF orientation, masks are resized and translated from selected pixels to the upstream transparent-alpha contract, URL-only results are rejected, uncertain billable submissions are never blindly resubmitted, aggregate inputs and direct concurrency are bounded and admin direct mode fails startup unless its six-times-per-worker memory envelope is satisfied. GPT Image 2 flexible sizes are rejected before upstream unless they meet the official alignment, edge, aspect and pixel constraints and the decoded RGBA budget. Large edit surfaces retain bounded deterministic ROI masks; the cloud boundary recompiles and verifies them from typed annotations before the provider restores them to the base size, while the cloud Job freezes the original output dimensions. The focused image/production regression passes 122 tests with two skips, the clean complete Python v1 suite passes 1,970 with 17 explicit environment/platform skips, and 22 adjacent v0.2.9.2 migration/product tests preserve the deletion authority. The real import remains deletion-safe: 54 authoritative sessions retained, 93 cache-only deleted IDs excluded and zero restored. Managed Gateway/device-session, real provider-backed concurrency/precision and protected macOS/live acceptance remain absent, so publication and rollout stay closed.
